text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The time has come! Among the abundant
shrines
and temples of Kyoto, we face
the grand trial for
the Kikuka crown!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
We worked so hard to get here, I can
almost see
my life passing before my
eyes...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gasp! You're right! This is still only the beginning!
choice_data_list_en: This is no time to be dropping dead...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho is a fiendishly long
3,000 meters.
I've never raced such a
distance before...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But with all this luck I've scraped
together, I'm
sure we'll make it through
somehow!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Go forth, my little lucky charms! Crush
my
competition! And maybe level off the
dreaded
Yodo Hill while you're at it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'll just sit back and see how it goes...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I know! I'm doing my part. I
drank my
lucky milk today to keep my
energy up.
choice_data_list_en: I won't just watch, I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If we get through this, no one will be
able to
stand against my faith. O gods,
let them see the
power of unparalleled
luck!
